newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Island Trees UFSD, N.Y..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF BOND SALE
Island Trees Union Free School District
(Nassau County)
New York
School District (Serial) Bonds - 1997

Sealed proposals will be received and considered by the Island Trees Union Free School District, in the County of Nassau, State of New York (the School District''), at the offices of Sullivan & Donovan, LLP, 415 Madison Avenue, 16th Floor, New York, New York 10017, at 11:00 A.M., Prevailing Time, on the
26th day of June, 1997,
at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase at not less than par and accrued interest to the date of closing.
The Bonds will be dated July 15, 1997, with interest
payable on January 15, 1999 and semi-annually thereafter on July 15 and January 15 in each year until maturity and shall mature on January 15 in the years and in the annual
principal installments which, together with interest
thereon, as follows:
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The School District reserves the right to change the time and/or date for the opening of bids. Notice of any such change shall be provided not less than 48 hours prior to the time set forth for the opening of bids by means of a supplemental notice of sale to be transmitted over the munifacts wire. The Bonds will be initially issued in registered form in denominations such that one bond shall be issued for each maturity of Bonds in such amounts as set forth above, and when issued will be registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of the Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as securities depository for the Bonds. The Bonds may not be converted into coupon bonds or be
registered to bearer. Bonds maturing on or before January 15, 2006 will not subject to redemption prior to maturity. Bonds maturing on January 15, 2007 and thereafter, will be subject to
redemption prior to maturity at the option of the School District, prior to maturity, in whole or in part, at the option of the School District on any date on or after

January 15, 2006, at the redemption prices (expressed percentage of the par) as follows: January 15, 2006 to July 15, 2006, 102%; January 15, 2007 and July 15, 2007, 101%; and January 15, 2008 and thereafter, 100%. Each bid must be for all of said $5,700,400 serial bonds and may state different rates of interest for Bonds maturing in different calendar years; provided, however, that (i) only one rate of interest may be bid for all Bonds maturing in any one calendar year, (ii) the maximum difference between the highest and lowest rate of interest bid for the Bonds may not exceed two per centum per annum, (iii) variations in rates of interest so bid shall be in ascending progression in order of maturity so that the rate of interest on bonds maturing in any particular calendar year shall not be less than the rate of interest applicable to bonds maturing in any prior calendar year, and (iv) all rates of interest bid must be stated in a multiple of one- eighth or one-hundredth of one per centum per annum. Unless all bids are rejected, the award will be made to the bidder complying with the terms of sale and offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest true interest cost computed in accordance with the true interest cost method of calculation, that being the rate which, compounded semi-annually, is necessary to

discount all principal and interest payments on the Bonds to the purchase price (excluding accrued interest) bid for the Bonds. The true interest cost computation should be made as of the dated date of the Bonds. If two or more such bidders offer to purchase the Bonds at the same true interest cost, computed as described above, the bonds will be awarded to the bidder whose bid offers to purchase the Bonds at the highest premium dollar amount. The right is reserved to reject any or all bids, and any bid not complying with this Notice of Sale will be rejected. Each bid must be enclosed in a sealed envelope addressed to the President of the Board of Education, and should be marked on the outside "Proposal for Bonds" and should be accompanied with a certified or cashier's check drawn upon an incorporated bank or trust company to the order of said School District, for $114,008 as a good faith deposit to secure the School District against any loss resulting from the failure of the bidder to comply with the terms of his bid. No interest will be
allowed on the amount of the good faith deposit. The purchaser will be furnished without cost, the

unqualified legal opinion as to the validity of the Bonds of Sullivan & Donovan, LLP, New York and East Meadow, New York, Bond Counsel. For further information regarding the bonds and to obtain copies of the Notice of Bond Sale, Bid Form, and the Preliminary Official Statement of the School District, please contact the School District's financial advisor: Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., 85 North Broadway, Hicksville, New York 11801, telephone 516-433-8555,
telecopier: 516-433-0628, or James A. Moyer, Esq. of
Sullivan & Donovan, LLP telephone (212) 935-5100, telec (212) 935-5106.

/s/ Jerome P. Donahue
President of the Board of Education

County of Nassau
